yūtha: Yūtha (nt.) [Vedic yūtha] 떼, 짐승의 무리 Sn 53 (코끼리의); J I.170 (원숭이의), 280 (id.); SnA 322 (go°, 소의). --pa 무리의 우두머리 Th 2, 437 (코끼리들). --pati same J III.174 (코끼리); DhA I.81 (id.).
yūthikā: Yūthikā (f.) [cp. later Sk. yūthikā] 일종의 자스민, Jasminum auriculatum J VI.537; Miln 338. J V.420 (for yodhi) & 422 에서도 그렇게 읽어야 함 (yodhikā & yudhikā). See also yodhikā.
yūpa: Yūpa [Vedic yūpa] 1. 희생제의 기둥 D I.141; A IV.41; J IV.302; VI.211; Miln 21 (dhamma°); SnA 321, 322; DA I.294. -- 2. pāsāda, 또는 궁궐 Th 1, 163=J II.334. --ussāpana 희생에의 기둥을 세움 DhsA 145 (cp. Miln 21).
yūsa: Yūsa [Vedic yūṣan, later Sk. yūṣa; fr. base Idg. *i̯ūs, cp. Lat. jūs soup, Gr. zu/mh yeast, ferment, zwmo/s soup; Obulg. jucha=Ger. jauche manure; Swedish ōst cheese; an enlargement of base *i̯eu to mix, as in Sk. yu to mix: see yuta, to which further *i̯eṷe, as in yuñjati] 1. 즙 Vin I.206 (akaṭa° 천연 즙); Mhvs 28, 26; VvA 185 (badara° 대추 즙); Vism 195 (seda° 축축한 유동체). -- 2. 죽, 미음. 네 종류의 죽이 M I.245 에 열거되어 있음, viz. mugga° bean soup, kulattha° 연리초 죽 (also at Vism 256), kaḷāya° (닭고기--) 완두콩 죽, hareṇuka° 완두콩 죽; Miln 63 (rañño sūdo yūsaṃ vā rasaṃ vā kareyya).
